durableFields.notes: Owns ordinary Spell Slot refund/reset deltas. Task 95 corrected the Arcane Recovery refund boundary to compare requested refunds against build-derived ordinary Spell Slot capacity plus current ordinary expenditure without adding a parallel slot-capacity field.

Owns Arcane Recovery use lockout state and use-lockout rejection routing. Short Rest Arcane Recovery adds the lockout; Long Rest clears it through the existing restFeatureUses reset. Public route projection emits a Feature Resource route for the already-used-until-Long-Rest boundary.

Owns the Pact Slot rejection boundary for Arcane Recovery: Pact Slots remain separate from ordinary Spell Slots and cannot satisfy ordinary-slot recovery. Public route projection emits a Pact Slot route only for pact-slot-shaped shortages, not generic ordinary over-refund failures.
